text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM. I checked all six of Moss's notes on the shared drive, which are all public.

1. **#PD-4492** is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Eau Claire Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct. One follow-up was to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419** is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea also logged this one: the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware. The note has no date, so I can't tell whether that's still the current status.

Three things to keep out of the weekly notes:
- **#4409 and #4412** are in Moss's Central handoffs digest, but they're Marrow Fieldworks tickets, not Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- **Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways"** (one "r") is about a different company that isn't a customer.
- **Moss's other three notes** (the 9/14 pipeline digest, the 3/23 renewal check-in and the Central cheat sheet) mention the account but don't give any ticket numbers.
